says: In today's CI, SC21 requires the law input to have a description, but no plant in scheduled.test.ts takes it away, so the clause has no law.
proof: In a scratch copy, `described(law)` in dispatchInputs was replaced with `true`. `CI=1 nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 .github/ci/workflow-lint/scheduled.test.ts` printed `Tests 302 passed (302)`. The plants list has `SC21: the scope has no description` (scheduled.test.ts:1217) and no law counterpart.
cost: The check can be dropped without a red test.
